seed_weighting: Original8 retained, two existing linked groups each member1/2; four singleton members1. Thus seed6 distinct-region mass per view. No averaging, relocation or retrospective6-row rewrite.

loss_admission: Known label0/1 AND full original uncertainty continuous box contained in unchanged half-open tilewindow AND full uncertainty box inside original image. Unknown/MISS/PARTIAL have training_label=-1 and loss0. Input tile list is never filtered.

spatial_statistic.coordinate_dtype: Raw GT geometry float64; normalized model sampling grid float32.
spatial_statistic.target_reduction: region_logit = arithmetic mean of nine sampled logits; one BCEWithLogits(region_logit,label) per tile/cue/view. Do not average nine independent BCE losses or assert nine pixel-material labels.
spatial_statistic.reference_only: Original r normalized coords retained for diagnostic only.
spatial_statistic.warning: These are regional hypotheses within annotation uncertainty, not dense foreground labels or nine certified cue pixels.

tile_weights.base_loss_weight: geometry_tile_weight iff known label; otherwise0. Each known cue/view sums1, per scale128/256 sums.5.
tile_weights.loss_weight: base_loss_weight*duplicate_weight. Known seedlinkedmember effective sum1/n; this is separate from per-cue/view base normalization.

spatial_overlap: All sparse D/E contributions retained separately with explicit cell-level bilinear support collision reports; no last-write-wins mask/raster labels.
primary_public_evaluation_proposal: Run every frozen GT-free tile, fuse spatial maps over native pixels with a prospective fixed input-geometry-only rule, then GT-only evaluate unchanged reference/uncertainty region. Do not select best tile by GT or recentre inputs. Exact fusion/threshold/checkpoint/gates are for root to freeze separately.
